dedupe_keys.name: harnessing smartphone sensors for enhanced road safety a comprehensive dataset and review

description: Harnessing Smartphone Sensors for Enhanced Road Safety: A Comprehensive Dataset and Review is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Amith Khandakar et al. Severe collisions can result from aggressive driving and poor road conditions. Monitoring is used to identify these conditions. Smartphones, with their array of built-in sensors, offer a practical and affordable solution for road-sensing. However, the lack of reliable, standardized datasets has hindered progress in assessing road conditions and driving patterns. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 93690612 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
